prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin across all change types; at least 2 tests of a kind are required to establish a rule.
Predictions were consistently too high across all change types compared to noise-corrected measurements.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen changes (only 1 test, which performed worse at -4.8% after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish new_screen changes (only 1 test, which showed no clear effect at +1.7% after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for sign_in reorder changes (only 1 test, which showed no clear effect at -0.5% after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish redesign changes (only 1 test, which performed worse at -6.3% after noise correction).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -4.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -6.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Centered Stage Redesign: Redesign the path selection screen with a centered stage layout presenting starter options clearly. (why: The choose_path step drops 23.8% of users with a high mean duration of 514s.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Spawn Guidance Screen: Add a new screen right before waiting completes showing visual instructions on where the pet appears on the taskbar. (why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to show on desktop or the app stalling.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Photo Styling Customization Flow: Introduce a stage layout with photo picker and preview components during photo upload. (why: Adoption stage has only 60.9% conversion and users report custom pets looking wrong or failing.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Adoption Certificate: Reorder the onboarding sequence so sign-in happens after adoption certificate creation. (why: Signing in early causes 27.1% drop-off and support issues with missing pets on re-auth.)
4: [finish, layout] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Card: Switch home intro to a checklist layout displaying key pet interaction shortcuts. (why: Multiple users emailed support asking how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding.)
5: [home, wait_info] Live Generation Progress Wait Info: Display dynamic progress bar and estimated time on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting screen has a long median time of 201s and mean of 2336s.)
6: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Name Validation Hint: Add an explicit explanatory hint on the adoption certificate screen about name binding to accounts. (why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) and users report pet state loss after authentication.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Story Intro Pet Features Refresh: Update story screen text and button label to set clear expectations before path choice. (why: Initial path choice stage drops 23.8% of incoming users.)

scores.note: Choose_path has moderate drop (23.8%) and high mean duration; evidence comes only from funnel, and redesigns carry high cost.
Home step drop is 18.7% supported by emails, but new screen changes have shown negative or flat results in past tests.
Adoption has highest drop (39.1%) and direct support reports, though full interactive flow requires heavy effort.
Sign_in loses 27.1% and has support backing, but reordering in past tests showed -0.5% effect.
Finish step drops 35.2% and support mails ask for controls; layout change is moderate cost.
Home wait time is very high (201s median), progress UI directly addresses long wait transparency.
Targets highest drop step (adoption 39.1%) backed by support complaints; minimal implementation cost.
Low cost copy change addressing initial 23.8% drop on path selection screen.
